items.difficulty_reason: 30 行陈述（80 行证明）、Gysin 映射与相对循环帽作用的交换图：包络下降段逐等式具名（closed-in-X-gysin 两处、action-push-pull 两处）加完全分解包络满射收尾；局部化段引 action-opens；归约段引 get-cycles 与 equation-cycle-classes 加线性性归约到单个平坦类乘单个素循环；末两情形 W 含于 D 双边为零、W 不含于 D 用 action-closed 两次在纤维积上显式算闭合。10 处引用全具名，无 omit，干净收。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-action-gysin (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 2605-2634

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: Reduce to a base change by an envelope by verifying the desired commutativity on the surjective pushforward image using the Gysin base change lemma twice and the push-pull formula for the cap action twice, then use locality of the operators on opens to work affinely, use the proper cover lemma to put the relative cycle into the image of the cycle-classes construction and reduce by linearity to a single cycle class of a flat closed subscheme against a single prime cycle, dispose of the case where the prime cycle lies inside the divisor where both sides vanish, and in the remaining case evaluate both sides explicitly with the flat closed-pair cap formula giving the same class on the fibred products (source lines 2636-2715)
